messages:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: INCIDENT ALERT — GPU-pool-eu-2 capacity exhaustion detected. Queue growth > 6000 reqs, tail latency > 10s. Auto-scale started but scale action repeatedly failed (provider quota error). Root TS: 1718509999

alex_oncall: on it. seeing repeated errors in autoscaler logs `QuotaExceeded`. Are we hitting cloud limit or our own throttle?

raj_sre: attaching logs. looks like scale-up API returned 429 then 403 quota. failure reason in stack: provider returned "InsufficientAcceleratorQuota" for family A100.

ops-bot: @channel page triggered: GPU_POOL_EXHAUSTION — severity: high — paged: @alex_oncall @raj_sre @sara_platform

alex_oncall: first mitigation: enable emergency routing to dedicated-pool-3 for critical customers, reduce noncritical concurrency. starting now.

emily_prod: which customers are considered critical? need to call out impacted tenants for comms.

raj_sre: critical tag = customers with reserved-capacity or SLO-tag production. I'll run a query and post list.

raj_sre: query result: tenants: redwood-ai, partner-inc, acme-dev. Redirecting their traffic to dedicated-pool-3. noncritical workloads will receive 429s if queue > 2k.

alex_oncall: executing route switch:
```
./infractl route update --from gpu-pool-eu-2 --to dedicated-pool-3 --filter "tenant in (redwood-ai,partner-inc,acme-dev)" --dry-run=false
```

ops-bot: route update acknowledged, progress logs: step1 done, step2 in progress.

alex_oncall: route change completed. Confirming traffic flow and health probes.

raj_sre: health: dedicated-pool-3 accepted traffic but backend util at 95%. We're avoiding full hot-shatter by throttling nonessential streams.

alex_oncall: second mitigation: reduce model size for noncritical routes (downgrade to quantized variant). Applying rollout.

sara_platform: quick note — autoscaler retries are failing because provider's quota API is inconsistent. I'll open ticket with provider and request temporary quota bump. Also enabling manual scale as fallback.

emily_prod: customer comms draft: "We're experiencing degraded performance due to resource constraints in EU. Critical workloads are routed to reserved capacity; noncritical requests may be throttled or queued. We're actively mitigating and will update in 30m." Any objections?

alex_oncall: go ahead and send. include link to status page + expected RTO 45m.

raj_sre: adding debug snippet for runbook and for PMs:
```
# failing autoscale logs
2024-07-14T02:33:12Z autoscaler: request_scale(+4) -> provider API -> 429 (RateLimit)
2024-07-14T02:33:13Z autoscaler: retry -> provider API -> 403 (InsufficientAcceleratorQuota)
2024-07-14T02:34:01Z autoscaler: abort -> mark pool degraded
```

alex_oncall: manual scale attempt (force-add nodes) succeeded after provisioning via spare-account: nodes added +4 to dedicated-pool-3. queue length now dropping from 6200 -> 3800.

emily_prod: tracking customer impact: redwood-ai saw 18% error uplift, partner-inc 12% latency increase, acme-dev had 25% timeouts. We'll include these numbers in postmortem.

sara_platform: action item raised: (1) add cross-account rescue path for emergency provisioning; (2) add provider quota alert earlier; (3) improve autoscaler retry/backoff policy to detect persistent quota errors and fallback to manual ops.

raj_sre: also adding telemetry: annotate autoscale failures with provider error code and include in pager message. Helps oncall make faster decision to route.

alex_oncall: handoff plan: I'll remain oncall for 30m to stabilize then hand off to morning shift. @sara_platform @raj_sre please validate the provider ticket and confirm quota bump ETA.

ops-bot: incident status update: mitigations applied, queue decreasing, active errors down. Next update in 20m.

sara_platform: provider responded: temporary quota increase requested, ETA 2h. They suggested region-level constraints. Not ideal. Will escalate to partner contact to shorten.

emily_prod: postmortem notes (to capture now): timeline, customer impact metrics, mitigations executed (routing, manual scale, model downgrade), and action items (rescue path, quota alerting, autoscaler logic hardening). I'll start the doc.

raj_sre: quick playbook edit suggestion: when autoscale returns 403 InsufficientAcceleratorQuota -> immediately trigger manual-scale-checklist and route critical traffic. treat 403 as non-transient.

alex_oncall: agreed. Adding that to playbook and to runbook PR now.

emily_prod: sending status update to customers and ops channel now. ETA for full recovery depends on provider quota bump. If we can keep traffic on dedicated pools and manual scale, RTO likely < 2h.

alex_oncall: final note: retrospective owners: sara_platform (provider/quota fixes), raj_sre (autoscaler/retries + telemetry), emily_prod (customer comms + postmortem). I'll mark incident resolved when queue < 200 and error rates back to baseline.

ops-bot: INCIDENT UPDATE: queue 420 -> continuing monitoring. Incident not yet resolved.

(emily_prod and alex_oncall coordinated handoff)

alex_oncall: handing off to morning crew at 1718510600. leaving runbook edits + checklist in #incidents-playbooks. Good work team. :thumbsup:

emily_prod: noted. I'll own the postmortem write-up and share draft in 3 hours.

raj_sre: added follow-ups to backlog: autoscaler behavior audit, quota-based heuristic, emergency-rescue automation.

sara_platform: filing provider escalation and proposing short-term contract for emergency capacity for critical tenants.

ops-bot: INCIDENT STATUS: monitoring-only. last update 1718510600.
